assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough constraints from the repository site package.
assumptions.impact: They support generation, visualization and content review, but not official redline or precise-area claims; all dependent layers and metrics must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Statutory FAR, building height, density, setbacks, land-use controls and facility standards were not supplied.
assumptions.impact: Submitted intensity metrics describe conceptual soft-embed nodes only and are not approved planning controls.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, station interfaces, traffic counts, parking supply and non-motorized conditions were not supplied.
assumptions.impact: Road centerlines and design widths are conceptual test alignments; transport engineering and accessibility review are required.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, tenancy, existing building survey and lawful-use records were not supplied.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level retain, renovate or demolition conclusion is made; building features represent reversible concept nodes.

assumptions.statement: Power, telecom, drainage, flood control, fire access, underground space and heat-recovery conditions were not supplied.
assumptions.impact: Micro-compute and energy concepts require municipal, fire, environmental and operations studies before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Detailed heritage protection zones, archaeological constraints and cleared audiovisual asset inventories were not supplied.
assumptions.impact: Heritage interpretation remains low-impact and reversible; all content and physical interfaces require heritage and copyright review.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, event permits and long-term service agreements are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Phasing and annual programming are reference scenarios, not government commitments or funding claims.
